title: Vanishing of theta descents: reflection sums at the level, and climbing the theta tower
summary: Two vanishing results for theta descents (DescentsVanish: every descent of Y from U(V) to U(W), with a datum that is the vacuum at a given set of places, is 0). For an auxiliary pair O: if psi is nontrivial at Q, reflection sums of nonzero rows at the chosen places kill y, and the descents with data P tensor Upsilon vanish, then all descents of conj(algFormCoeff(u, y)) with data vacuum off the places of O vanish (descentsVanish_of_reflectionSum, via lv: moving coset indicators by integral elements changes y by chosenGLRep). And adding hyperbolic planes: if descents to W vanish and Y is killed by a Hecke polynomial at a split place with a root that is too small, the descents to W + H^p vanish (descentsVanish_add_planes), by induction on p, a Hecke transfer, a maximum principle for bounded functions killed by a Hecke polynomial (eq_zero_of_heckePolyOp_eq_zero), and the Iwasawa decomposition for the zero term (integral_sourceTerm_eq_zero).

members.text: Let E be a CM field with Weil data, O an auxiliary pair over E (W(O) of rank r, V = I_n), y a form in FormV(O) and u a linear functional on coordinate vectors of weight kappa(O). Assume (hQ) psi(O, w) is nontrivial at every twist place w of O; (hM) for every chosen place i and every family v = (v_j), v_j in k_{w_j}^r for the chosen places j, with v_i nonzero, the element piTensorElem((reflectionSum(psi(O, w_j), v_j))_j) of the group algebra of prod_j GL_r(k_{w_j}) kills y through formAction(O); and (h0) for every polynomial P, the descent Space.lift(swap of pairThetaKer(W(O), stdSpace(E, n), a(O), 1), v_P tensor auxDatum(O), conj(algFormCoeff(1, u)(y)), g) is 0 for every point g, where v_P is the Fock vector of P. Then F = 0.
